definitions.explanation: A person or family that engages in farming; also refers to the farmhouse itself.

examples.japanese: {農家|のうか}から{直接|ちょくせつ}{野菜|やさい}を{買|か}う。
examples.english: I buy vegetables directly from farmers.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{農家|のうか}で{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: My grandfather grew up on a farm.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{農家|のうか}を{支援|しえん}する。

notes:
USAGE: {農家|のうか} can refer to (1) a farmer/farming family, or (2) a farmhouse.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{農家|のうか}の{人|ひと} (farmer)
・{農家|のうか}で{育|そだ}つ (to grow up on a farm)
・{農家|のうか}を{営|いとな}む (to run a farm)
・{農家|のうか}{直送|ちょくそう} (direct from the farm)

RELATED WORDS:
・{農民|のうみん} - farmer, peasant (more emphasis on the person)
・{農業|のうぎょう} - agriculture, farming
・{農村|のうそん} - farming village
・{農地|のうち} - farmland
・{専業|せんぎょう}{農家|のうか} - full-time farmer
・{兼業|けんぎょう}{農家|のうか} - part-time farmer
